text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When training time came and I headed
to the track, I noticed a crowd of people
gathered around for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling suspicious, I push my way through the crowd, and—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —Here! Just hold your hand over this magatama and your luck will improve!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A carved wooden bear that makes you feel great just by touching it!
A Noh mask that lets you fly through the sky just by stroking it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, everyone, let me share some good fortune with you!
Please, go ahead and give it a try!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Matikanefukukitaru was spreading out a large cloth, peddling good luck charms to the passing Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Trainer!
Why don't you have some too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried stroking the sky-flying Noh mask to test it out...
...but nothing happened.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Is that right! But it's totally fine!
After all, good fortune has been rolling in non-stop!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Because it's been a non-stop winning streak, you know?! Good fortune, good fortune, good fortune—everywhere I look, there's good fortune!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's totally happening, isn't it?!
It's undeniably coming our way, right?!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "True, she has claimed numerous victories, including the Kyoto Shimbun Hai, Kobe Shimbun Hai, and Kikuka Sho. One could say good fortune is on her side. However—"
choice_data_list: (Isn't this going a little too well...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Ever since winning the Kikuka-sho, she's been acting a bit off. I'm worried she might be letting it get to her head..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Right when I was thinking that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, my~ Lady Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am so pleased to see you in such fine spirits today as well.
Autumn has deepened, and the weather is simply lovely, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well, if it isn't Bright-san!
Just in the nick of time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"We spend a lot of time together normally,
but lately I've felt a particularly special bond with you!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: After all, we often run in the same races! So, for someone like you, I have a special item to offer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure?
Could you please tell me what kind of item it is, then?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
Simply put—the Great Deity Kamaboko!!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! Literally what it sounds like, a great deity carved from a fish cake board!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's modeled after a swift-footed deity,
and they say holding onto it may or may not shave seconds off your time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...! What a wonderful item.
I'm truly grateful~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The misshapen Kamaboko Daimyojin
was handed over to Mejiro Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I shall carry it with me every day
so that its blessings may reach me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think that's a great idea!
After all, the effects are simply tremendous—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, you'll never be able to beat
Lady Matikanefukukitaru, now will you~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: âHuh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I may have suffered a few defeats,
but that is all in the past now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I firmly believe that beyond a string of narrow defeats
lies victory~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall surely seize victory.
A glorious, resplendent victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Look at the time~.
Well then, I shall be off to training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Until the day I claim victory,
farewell, Matikanefukukitaru-sama~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath that gentle smile, a fierce fighting spirit flashed for a moment.
Just as I wondered how Matikanefukukitaru would react—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And to everyone's surprise—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Would you look at that! If you can beat me...!?
Even when good fortune is totally on my side!?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You really are something else... Bright-san!
But the gods are watching over me too!!
After all, I have my Chikuwabu Bishamonten!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Riding high on momentum, Matikane Fukukitaru was unfazed by Mejiro Bright's fighting spirit,
and instead got fired up herself."
